tags.feature: Introducing a brand-new [b]Daily Summary Panel[/b]—get an at-a-glance overview of your resort’s key metrics every morning. Track income, resource consumption, best seller brew, and more in one convenient dashboard.
We’ve given our gacha draws a facelift! Enjoy smoother transitions, snappier effects, and a more satisfying “cha-ching” moment when rare ingredients pop up.
Venture deeper into the realm with the [b]Research Tree[/b]. Unlock advanced recipes, new upgrades as you progress through each branching path.

notes.title: Beer Onsen Resort - Latest Update! 🍻✨
notes.content:
[h3]New Features:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Gacha Machine UI Revamp[/b]: A fresh new design for a better visual experience.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602789/f937f653aa32412624ef3e3a44ba02b9ba49b465.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602789/ddc5a85ae0cca379c0aed6e33615e6a0597efd9f.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Date Display[/b]: The game now features a date display, enhancing immersion.[/p][/*][*][p][b]More Tutorials[/b]: Added additional tutorials to guide new players through the brewing process.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Encyclopedia Page[/b]: A comprehensive new page to check detailed information about all the drinks and ingredients.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ingredient Detail Screen[/b]: Click on ingredients to view detailed descriptions and properties.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Pop-up Panel[/b]: After brewing a new beer, a pop-up panel will automatically display with details of your creation.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Localization Issues[/b]: Resolved language display issues for a smoother experience worldwide.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tutorial Bugs[/b]: Fixed bugs in the tutorial for a quicker, smoother onboarding process.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: [b]Gacha Machine UI Revamp[/b]: A fresh new design for a better visual experience.
[b]Date Display[/b]: The game now features a date display, enhancing immersion.
[b]More Tutorials[/b]: Added additional tutorials to guide new players through the brewing process.
[b]Encyclopedia Page[/b]: A comprehensive new page to check detailed information about all the drinks and ingredients.
[b]Ingredient Detail Screen[/b]: Click on ingredients to view detailed descriptions and properties.
[b]New Pop-up Panel[/b]: After brewing a new beer, a pop-up panel will automatically display with details of your creation.

tags.bug: [b]Localization Issues[/b]: Resolved language display issues for a smoother experience worldwide.
[b]Tutorial Bugs[/b]: Fixed bugs in the tutorial for a quicker, smoother onboarding process.
